Tests epoch leader schedule generation and lookup against fixture data.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for `fd_epoch_leaders`, which builds and queries the leader schedule for a Solana epoch. It imports fixture data for Mainnet-beta epoch 454, converts stake data into the form required by the leader schedule code, and creates an `fd_epoch_leaders_t` object with `fd_epoch_leaders_new`. The program then checks that `fd_epoch_leaders_get` returns the expected leader pubkey for each slot, first against a stored list of pubkeys for the first part of the epoch and then against the slot-to-index mapping for the full epoch. It also checks boundary cases before and after the epoch range.

The file also tests behavior when only part of the validator set is available. It rebuilds the leader schedule with half of the validators excluded through `excluded_stake`, then verifies that slots assigned to excluded validators return `FD_INDETERMINATE_LEADER` and that slots assigned to included validators still return the expected identity key. The code uses `FD_TEST` checks for validation, and it ends by logging `pass` and halting the process.
